title: Ferguson Joins the S&P 500®
summary: Ferguson Enterprises Inc. (NYSE: FERG), North America’s largest value-added distributor of essential water and air solutions in our $340B residential and non-residential construction markets, has been selected for inclusion in the SP 500® index effective at the open of trading on August 5, 2026. “Joining the SP 500 is a significant milestone made possible by our 35,000 expert associates and their commitment to the specialized professionals who build and maintain North America,” said Kevin Murphy, Ferguson CEO. “This recognition is a testament to the dedication of our associates, the strength of our business model and the leading positions we hold in the market.” Over the last five years, the company has transitioned from a London listed, FTSE 100 company to a solely NYSE listed, fully North American headquartered company. The addition to the SP 500 marks the final step in this journey. The SP 500 is widely recognized as one of the premier benchmarks of the U.S.
